# DVO Corp (dvocorp.com)

> DVO Corp is a small DevOps team from Ukraine. We design, launch and operate
> production infrastructure for software products: AWS and EKS, Kubernetes,
> Terraform / infrastructure as code, CI/CD, monitoring and alerting, security,
> cloud cost optimisation, migrations and ongoing support. We work in the
> client's cloud accounts or host applications on our own infrastructure, and
> we ship single functions as pay-per-use API endpoints on our MetaPlatho
> platform. Clients: startups and companies in Ukraine and across Europe.
> Languages: Ukrainian, English.

## Contact

- Telegram: https://t.me/dvocorp
- Email: support@dvocorp.com, info@dvocorp.com
- Request form: https://dvocorp.com/en/contact/

## Services (English)

- [DevOps outsourcing](https://dvocorp.com/en/services/devops-outsourcing/): an infrastructure team without hiring one
- [AWS infrastructure](https://dvocorp.com/en/services/aws-devops/): accounts, VPC, EKS, RDS, delivery and cost review, all in Terraform
- [Kubernetes](https://dvocorp.com/en/services/kubernetes/): EKS and self-managed clusters, Helm, autoscaling, upgrades
- [Terraform and IaC](https://dvocorp.com/en/services/terraform-iac/): modules, importing existing resources, plan-on-PR
- [CI/CD](https://dvocorp.com/en/services/ci-cd/): GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, GitOps, rollbacks
- [Monitoring and alerts](https://dvocorp.com/en/services/monitoring/): Prometheus, VictoriaMetrics, Grafana, Loki
- [Cloud cost optimisation](https://dvocorp.com/en/services/cloud-cost-optimization/): bill audit, right-sizing, autoscaling
- [Infrastructure security](https://dvocorp.com/en/services/infrastructure-security/): access, secrets, network, backups
- [Cloud migration](https://dvocorp.com/en/services/cloud-migration/): between clouds or into a cluster, minimal downtime
- [Support and operations](https://dvocorp.com/en/services/infrastructure-support/): taking a running system under supervision
- [High load](https://dvocorp.com/en/services/high-load/): load testing, bottlenecks, scaling
- [Managed hosting](https://dvocorp.com/en/services/managed-hosting/): your application on our clusters
- [Custom API development](https://dvocorp.com/en/services/api-development/): your function as a pay-per-use endpoint
- [AI infrastructure](https://dvocorp.com/en/services/ai-infrastructure/): agents, model serving, GPU workers
- [DevOps for startups](https://dvocorp.com/en/services/devops-for-startups/): a minimal production setup that grows with the product

## Product

- [MetaPlatho](https://metaplatho.com): our own media-processing platform with a public REST API; it runs on the infrastructure we build and operate.
